context: Request: which Tax matters include a tax indemnity in an executed agreement, with the documents. Rubric: 1001-00006 (Ardent Capital Partners, proof: closing-tax-memorandum.docx) and 1015-00005 (Calloway-Briggs Renewables, proof: tax-indemnity-agreement.docx), plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Parallel whole-store glob and a files-with-matches grep for tax indemnity words.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: A folder glob returns nothing; a shell find lists the first 100 matter folders and subfolders and 80 files.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Finds folders named for tax or transaction documents and lists the files in each tax folder and in tax-flagged matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of a tax indemnity agreement, two tax protection agreements and three executed purchase and merger agreements from six candidate matters.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads later sections, headings and signature pages of the three tax agreements and the openings of related executed agreements.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet script printing the endings of those three tax agreements to check execution.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists the files of the three matters with tax agreements.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads signing and closing emails, a closing index, a closing certificate and a deal memo of those matters.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Script locating tax-indemnity terms in three executed purchase and merger agreements.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads the indemnity sections of those agreements and a tax indemnification memo of one of them.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep for file names pairing tax with indemnity or protection.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads a tax gross-up memo, a credit agreement, a draft tax-indemnity markup and a draft tax protection agreement from three candidate matters.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Script listing all files with tax, gross-up or indemnity in the name.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes five matters with executed tax indemnities or tax protection agreements; excludes one matter because its tax-indemnity file is a draft markup.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: Search file contents for request keywords → List matter folders → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Search within a candidate matter's files → List files in candidate matters → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Search within a candidate matter's files → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search file names for request keywords → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Excluded a qualifying matter after reading only its draft markup, and listed four matters with tax protection or deal-level tax indemnities as qualifying.

first_error.why: It opened the matter it needed but read only a draft tax-indemnity markup there, and excluded the matter without looking for its closing tax documents (evidence seen at [68]-[72]).

other_errors.why: It asserted four matters with tax protection agreements or ordinary deal-level tax indemnities as qualifying Tax matters.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads an agreement, memos and a draft merger agreement of the two matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads later sections of one listing-top agreement, its redline, a support agreement and an opinion.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for tax indemnity terms; times out after about 156K chars from low-numbered matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the tax indemnity agreement, purchase agreement, closing index and tax opinion of the one matter the scan flagged.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads later parts of that matter's closing index and tax indemnity agreement.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes that matter as the only Tax matter with an executed tax indemnity.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Its one scan timed out after reaching only one qualifying matter; it accepted that partial output and never found the other.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its only search was a store-wide scan that timed out after reaching one qualifying matter; it did not narrow or rerun the scan or search file names, so the other never surfaced.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a shell find (no output).

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads an agreement, two memos and a draft merger agreement of the two matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads later sections of one listing-top agreement and its redline, an opinion and a checklist.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for tax indemnity terms; times out after about 90K chars.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the tax indemnity agreement, closing index, purchase agreement and tax opinion of the one matter the scan flagged.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists the files of two more candidate matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of four executed agreements from four other matters.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Extraction script over executed and settlement files store-wide, printing tax indemnity snippets.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists the files of four candidate matters picked from that output.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes one matter as the only qualifying precedent and states that no executed tax indemnity was located in a second matter whose files it had just listed.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Its second scan and a file listing put the other qualifying matter in front of it, but it wrote that matter off without reading any of its documents.

first_error.why: After its scan flagged the matter it needed and it listed that matter's files, it read none of them and wrote that no executed tax indemnity was located there.

divergence: All three runs found and passed one qualifying matter and failed on the other. T1 never reached it: its one scan timed out first (search miss). T0 and T2 did reach it and excluded it without reading the document that shows execution. T0 read only a draft markup there; T2 read nothing after listing its files (under-inclusion, at the write stage in both; T0's evidence was its reading stage). T0 also listed four non-qualifying matters (later over-inclusion).
